name: web-search
description: Web and news search through Tavily, Brave Search or SerpAPI (provider and key from env; paid per query)

nodes.title: Web search
nodes.description: Search the web; returns {provider, query, answer, results: [{title, url, snippet, published_at, source}]} (paid per query)

country.description: 2-letter country code to localize results, e.g. ID, US (Brave, SerpAPI)

language.description: Language code, e.g. en, id (Brave, SerpAPI)

freshness.description: Only results from the last day, week, month or year

include_answer.description: Tavily only: add a short generated answer

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
